integrity: All-integer budget construction and Gaussian moments are proved; finite checks supplement rather than certify infinite statements. Scholarly novelty is qualified by unindexed-literature risk.
scientific_limitations: Ideal best-rank spectral oracle and two-choice diagnostic only; no claim about implemented randomized Nyström selection, fixed-dimensional bounds, finite-precision behavior, or wall-clock costs.
title: Unbounded oracle-look-ahead regret in Gaussian log-determinant budget allocation
